card.name: Verbs and nouns in narrative scenes
card.fires_on: No single word or setting fits. It fires on scattered words such as room, holds, stood, holding, stop and keep in narrative or scripture-style prose.

modes.label: Action verbs in stories
modes.description: A verb describing a bodily action or posture in a narrated scene.
modes.example: At the mere mention of the tempter, Clara, always the false prude,<< holds>> his hands and trembles.

modes.description: Words inside New Testament passages about husbands, wives and obligations.
